laichen.et: From Middle High German leichen (“to jump, rise, mate, spawn”). Despite the late attestation (14th c.) plausibly inherited from Proto-West Germanic *laikan (“to jump, play”). Alternatively denominal from Middle High German leich. Equivalent to Laich + -en.

Laich.et: From Middle High German leich. Identical with Leich and thus ultimately from Proto-Germanic *laikaz (dance, game).
